name: epuyendigital
description: Mesa de Entrada Digital - Municipalidad de Epuyén

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @epuyen/shared && npm run dev -w @epuyen/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @epuyen/shared && npm run dev -w @epuyen/worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w @epuyen/shared && npm run build -w @epuyen/web && npm run build -w @epuyen/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @epuyen/shared && npm run typecheck -w @epuyen/web && npm run typecheck -w @epuyen/worker && tsc -p supabase --noEmit
scripts.dev:local-bot: npm run build -w @epuyen/shared && npx tsx --env-file=.env scripts/local-bot-server.ts
